verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the automation pieces of this story but not the runbook model it describes. Workflows can trigger actions automatically on incident updates (e.g. auto-publishing to status pages), and integrations can automatically start a Teams meeting per incident. Investigations kick off automatically when an incident is declared, read your runbooks as context, and do diagnostic-style analysis against code and telemetry. Missing for 10: runbooks as attachable objects with executable steps, automatic incident channel creation, automatic task/action assignment from runbook steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
